propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Accepta tibi sit, Domine, sacratae plebis oblatio pro tuorum honore
Sanctorum: quorum se meritis de tribulatione percepisse cognoscit auxilium.
Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Phase3 selected exact reuse of newly checked Lasance/Walsh English, 2026-10-22. Historical source: Common of a Virgin not a Martyr, Dilexisti; printed p. 1373. Historical Latin and the seed agree in all words, including the actual Per Dominum. ending, after typography-only comparison. English retains Through our Lord. with no expansion, Amen or supplied name. The new source-verification passage owns the genuine prayer-level image inspection once; this target has a separate derivative TSV publication binding. Existing verification records remain unchanged. This is historical antecedent English, not official 1962 English or proof of Lasance's appointment of this recipient. Any former Cummiskey lead remains unbound and is not cleared by this Lasance reading. Independent cold source review remains required.
